text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki had been serializing a slapstick 
comedy manga about the students' daily 
lives. I heard it was receiving pretty 
good reviews from readers, but――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaaah...
choice_data_list:
...You seem pretty gloomy for someone 
getting great reviews?

...You seem pretty gloomy for someone 
getting great reviews?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well of course I am! Because...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When Earth-chan played music in an 
abandoned warehouse where cursed voices 
were allegedly heard, the cursed voices 
turned into a musical number ever 
since...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And when Gentildonna-senpai was invited to 
play soccer, she kicked the ball so hard 
it burst, showing off a "scattering magic 
shot"...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Everything happening around here is way 
more interesting than the imaginary 
everyday life I draw! Raw, unfiltered 
reality is just the most delicious of 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My pen can't beat reality... The more I 
think about that, the less I can get my 
pen to move lately...
choice_data_list: Don't be so down on yourself...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
――, you got a moment? I'd like to borrow 
Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I got my hands on a new board game, you 
see. I was just gathering players.

text_block_list.name: Game Participant
text_block_list.text:
Wahh~! My 'Archers' got wiped out!? Wait, 
am I completely checkmated now...!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The moment you stepped foot onto 
that swamp tile three turns ago, their 
fate was already sealed.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What incredible foresight...! And she's 
fully mastering the game's diverse unit 
types――'Dragon', 'Golem', and 'Mage'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(No, rather... in front of Ruler-senpai, 
even her opponents are just pieces to be 
freely manipulated!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... she truly is the Ruler of the 
Board!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's Kiseki's turn. Surely you 
can stir up this board――with another 
interesting move?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(――An 'interesting' move!? B-But... all I 
have left are the weakest pieces, the 
'Foot Soldiers'...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, i-it's no use! I... I can't think 
of any move to overturn this flawless 
board state...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa now. Isn't that line――a bit 'boring'?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Giving up without even putting up a fight 
in the face of an ironclad rule... is that 
the kind of character you are? ...I don't 
think so.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whether in 'manga' or 'reality'――you're 
the type to blaze a trail through your own 
hands and feet, creating the thrilling 
story you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Isn't that the kind of horse girl you are?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(She's right... Ruler-senpai's board state 
is certainly magnificent! But――)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Resisting an overwhelmingly powerful foe 
until the very end. Never giving up hope, 
fighting on――and seizing victory!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(That kind of development――is the exact 
'excitement' I believe in!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(And pulling that off... is what makes a 
true protagonist who moves people's 
hearts!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ............It's my turn. My move is――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I advance all my remaining pieces――all 
'Foot Soldiers'――into the mountain tiles! 
Charging straight for Ruler-senpai's 
headquarters!

text_block_list.name: Game Participant
text_block_list.text:
Eeehh!? Won't that leave your own 
headquarters wide open, Kiseki-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... 'Foot Soldiers' are the weakest 
in combat, but they're also the only unit 
whose movement isn't restricted by tile 
terrain.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Making use of their traits is fine and 
all... but will you make it in time? 
Before my pieces capture your 
headquarters, that is.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is the one and only winning path I 
can think of right now. In that case, all 
I can do is bet everything on it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, the weakest pieces scrambling 
desperately toward a near-zero chance of 
victory, fiercely struggling against the 
odds! That is――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt! Peak 'entertainment'!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heheh――that's the line I was waiting to 
hear! Now, show me! The 'thrilling story' 
that you weave!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later――while walking through 
the academy, I bumped into Kiseki, who had 
a noticeably refreshed look on her face.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've sorted things out.
Looks like you've sorted things out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That heated game with Ruler-senpai 
reminded me of something crucial.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That I'm someone who can create exciting 
developments that belong uniquely to me!
choice_data_list:
I'll be looking forward to a thrilling 
manga that's true to your style.

I'll be looking forward to a thrilling 
manga that's true to your style.

Then... Master T shall be your next 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That I'm someone who can create exciting 
developments that belong uniquely to me!
choice_data_list:
I'll be looking forward to a thrilling 
manga that's true to your style.

I'll be looking forward to a thrilling 
manga that's true to your style.

Then... Master T shall be your next 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! ...That's right. This 
academy is overflowing with exciting 
things...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And I am the horse girl who will turn all 
of that into the absolute greatest 
entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
!? Wh-Whoa, talk about a sudden plot 
twist!? However, as long as the story 
continues, fighting on is the 
protagonist's destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Very well. Even in our battle, I shall 
illustrate a truly fascinating story!
